notes: Playable regions (maps) of the Arab world. dlc = sold separately (Microsoft Store add-on / Steam DLC); comingSoon = shown locked in the map list. weather: heat = chance multiplier for heatwaves, rain = extra rain chance per day. market = sell price multiplier. currency is shown instead of SAR; prices keep the same numbers so the balance stays the same.

regions.descEn: Desert oasis farm: palms, wheat and greenhouses, scarce groundwater and hot summers.

regions.descEn: Below sea level: winter vegetables, bananas and dates.
regions.descAr: تحت مستوى البحر: خضار شتوية وموز وتمر

regions.descEn: Argan trees, citrus groves and greenhouse tomatoes between the Atlas and the ocean.
